filters.description: List of words to filter tweets by. Multiple filters are applied as multiple --filter flags.

user_languages.description: List of user languages to filter by (e.g., en, ja). Multiple languages are applied as multiple --user-language flags.

log_status.description: If true, log target statuses using the --log-status flag.

logger_type.description: Logger type. Select from stderr, gui.

log_level.description: Log level. Select from debug, info, warning, error, fatal, unknown.
